Assembly_CreateJointFixed.ToolTip:
1 - If an assembly is active : Creates a joint statically locking two parts together, preventing any movement or rotation

2 - If a part is active: Positions sub-parts by matching selected coordinate systems. The second part selected will move.

Draft_Polygon.ToolTip: Creates a regular polygon (triangle, square, pentagon…)

Draft_Fillet.ToolTip: Creates a fillet between 2 selected edges

BIM_Text.ToolTip: Create a text in the current 3D view or TechDraw page

BIM_Leader.ToolTip: Creates a polyline with an arrow at its endpoint

Draft_Label.ToolTip: Creates a label, optionally attached to a selected object or subelement

Draft_Hatch.ToolTip: Creates hatches on the faces of a selected object

Arch_Site.ToolTip: Creates a site including selected objects

Arch_Level.ToolTip: Creates a building part object that represents a level

Arch_Space.ToolTip: Creates a space object from selected boundary objects

Arch_Wall.ToolTip: Creates a wall object from scratch or from a selected object (wire, face or solid)

BIM_Column.ToolTip: Creates a column at a specified location

BIM_Beam.ToolTip: Creates a beam between two points

BIM_Slab.ToolTip: Creates a slab from a planar shape

BIM_Door.ToolTip: Places a door at a given location

Arch_Window.ToolTip: Creates a window object from a selected object (wire, rectangle or sketch)

BIM_Covering.ToolTip: Creates a covering (floor finish, cladding) on a selected face

Arch_Pipe.ToolTip: Creates a pipe object from a given wire or line

Arch_Roof.ToolTip: Creates a roof object from the selected wire.

Arch_Panel.ToolTip: Creates a panel object from scratch or from a selected object (sketch, wire, face or solid)

Arch_Frame.ToolTip: Creates a frame object from a planar 2D object (the extrusion path(s)) and a profile. Make sure objects are selected in that order.

Arch_Fence.ToolTip: Creates a fence object from a selected section, post and path

Arch_Truss.ToolTip: Creates a truss object from the selected line or from scratch

Arch_Equipment.ToolTip: Creates an equipment from a selected object (Part or Mesh)

Draft_Move.ToolTip:
Moves the selected objects.
If the "Copy" option is active, it creates displaced copies.

Draft_Rotate.ToolTip:
Rotates the selected objects.
If the "Copy" option is active, it will create rotated copies.

Draft_Scale.ToolTip: Scales the selected objects from a base point

Draft_Mirror.ToolTip: Mirrors the selected objects along a line defined by 2 points

BIM_Copy.ToolTip: Copies selected objects to another location

BIM_Compound.ToolTip: Creates a compound of several shapes

BIM_Trimex.ToolTip: Trims or extends the selected object

Draft_Join.ToolTip:
Joins the selected lines or polylines into a single object.
The lines must share a common point at the start or at the end.

Draft_Split.ToolTip: Splits the selected line or polyline at a specified point

Draft_Upgrade.ToolTip:
Upgrades the selected objects into more complex shapes.
The result of the operation depends on the types of objects, which may be able to be upgraded several times in a row.
For example, it can join the selected objects into one, convert simple edges into parametric polylines,
convert closed edges into filled faces and parametric polygons, and merge faces into a single face.

Draft_Downgrade.ToolTip:
Downgrades the selected objects into simpler shapes.
The result of the operation depends on the types of objects, which may be downgraded several times in a row.
For example, a 3D solid is deconstructed into separate faces, wires, and then edges. Faces can also be subtracted.

BIM_Material.ToolTip: Sets or creates a material for selected objects

Arch_Check.ToolTip: Checks the selected objects for problems

BIM_Glue.ToolTip: Joins selected shapes into one non-parametric shape

Draft_Arc.ToolTip: Creates a circular arc from a center point and a radius

Draft_Offset.ToolTip:
Offsets the selected object.
It can also create an offset copy of the original object.

BIM_Report.ToolTip: Create a new BIM Report to query model data with SQL

Arch_Schedule.ToolTip: Creates a schedule to collect data from the model

BIM_Clone.ToolTip: Clones selected objects to another location

BIM_Unclone.ToolTip: Creates a selected clone object independent from its original

BIM_Box.ToolTip: Graphically creates a generic box in the current document

Draft_Facebinder.ToolTip: Creates a facebinder from the selected faces

BIM_Shape2DView.ToolTip:
Creates a 2D projection of the selected objects on the XY-plane.
The initial projection direction is the opposite of the current active view direction.

BIM_Shape2DCut.ToolTip: Creates a 2D projection of only the intersecting faces of the selected objects on the XY-plane.

Arch_Nest.ToolTip: Nests a series of selected shapes in a container

Arch_Material.ToolTip: Creates or edits the material definition of a selected object.

CAM_Stop.ToolTip: Adds an optional or mandatory stop to the program

CAM_PropertyBag.ToolTip: Creates an object which can be used to store reference properties

CAM_Copy.ToolTip: Creates a linked copy of another toolpath

Draft_ArcTools.ToolTip: Tools to create various types of circular arcs

Draft_BezierTools.ToolTip: Tools to create various types of Bézier curves

Draft_Dimension.ToolTip: Creates a linear dimension for a straight edge, a circular edge, or 2 picked points, or an angular dimension for 2 straight edges

Draft_Trimex.ToolTip: Trims or extends the selected object

Draft_Clone.ToolTip: Creates a clone of the selected objects

Draft_Heal.ToolTip:
Heals faulty Draft objects saved with an earlier version of FreeCAD.
If an object is selected it tries to heal only that object,
otherwise it tries to heal all objects in the active document.
